articles.headline: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra Says Watching Berkeley’s ‘The Play’ Helped Shape A Leadership Quality He Later Brought To SanDisk
articles.summary: Micron's CEO credits a legendary college football play for teaching him tenacity. The lesson helped him lead SanDisk and Micron to success.
articles._summary: During the 1982 "Big Game" between the UC Berkeley Cal Bears and the Stanford Cardinal, Mehrotra watched from the stands as a young Berkeley student. With four seconds left, Cal pulled off a five-lateral kickoff return through the Stanford marching band to score a game-winning touchdown. In an interview with Business Insider, Mehrotra said he still remembers the moment vividly. "I was there, and it still gives me goosebumps," he said. "It was extremely exciting, an unbelievable finish."
articles._zh_headline: 美光首席执行官桑杰·梅赫罗特拉 (Sanjay Mehrotra) 表示，观看伯克利大学的“The Play”有助于塑造他后来带到 SanDisk 的领导素质
articles._zh_summary: 1982 年，加州大学伯克利分校熊队 (UC Berkeley Cal Bears) 与斯坦福大学红雀队 (Stanford Cardinal) 之间的“重大比赛”期间，作为一名年轻的伯克利学生，梅赫罗特拉 (Mehrotra) 在看台上观看了比赛。还剩四秒时，卡尔在斯坦福军乐队中完成五次横向开球回攻，取得了赢得比赛的达阵。梅赫罗特拉在接受《商业内幕》采访时表示，他仍然清楚地记得那一刻。 “我当时就在那里，但至今仍让我起鸡皮疙瘩，”他说。 “这非常令人兴奋，令人难以置信的结局。”

articles.headline: Inside a secretive Ukrainian team launching deep drone strikes at Russia
articles.summary: Ukraine's long-range drones are striking deep inside Russia, up to 1,200 miles away, hitting oil refineries and depots. NPR recently spent time with one of the Ukrainian strike teams launching drones at Russian targets.
articles._summary: Soldiers from the First Center of Unmanned Systems launch a deep-strike drone from an undisclosed location in eastern Ukraine. Serhii Korovvayny for NPR hide caption EASTERN UKRAINE — As the sun sets on a vast farm field, soldiers in full body armor pull over on a dirt road and unload what looks like a miniature jet from a truck. This drone, made by Fire Point, a Ukrainian defense technology company, can travel between 800 and 1,200 miles. Ukraine's military has used drones like these to repeatedly hit oil refineries and depots deep inside Russia, including Moscow and even Siberia. On June 18, Ukraine launched its largest drone offensive yet on Moscow and hit an oil refinery. Thick black smoke billowed into the sky as residents reported a flurry of "oil rain." People walk in a park as black smoke rises from the area of the Russian oil producer Gazprom Neft's Moscow oil refinery on the southeastern outskirts of Moscow on June 18, 2026.

articles._zh_summary: 来自第一无人系统中心的士兵从乌克兰东部的一个秘密地点发射了一架深度打击无人机。 NPR 的 Serhii Korovvayny 隐藏标题 乌克兰东部 — 当太阳落在广阔的农田上时，身穿全身装甲的士兵把车停在土路上，从卡车上卸下看起来像一架微型喷气式飞机的东西。这架无人机由乌克兰国防技术公司 Fire Point 制造，飞行距离可达 800 至 1,200 英里。乌克兰军方多次使用此类无人机袭击俄罗斯境内的炼油厂和油库，包括莫斯科甚至西伯利亚。 6月18日，乌克兰对莫斯科发动迄今为止最大规模的无人机攻势，并袭击了一座炼油厂。浓浓黑烟冲天，居民报告称出现了一阵“油雨”。 2026 年 6 月 18 日，莫斯科东南郊，俄罗斯石油生产商俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司 (Gazprom Neft) 的莫斯科炼油厂冒出黑烟，人们在公园里散步。

articles._summary: Nasdaq confirmed Friday that SpaceX will be added to the tech-heavy Nasdaq-100 index effective July 7, less than a month after the company’s June 12 public debut . SpaceX’s rapid addition follows recent changes by Nasdaq to make its exchange more attractive to companies pursuing U.S. listings.
